messages.author: 84db03807b3d3288
messages.subject: shiny::shine S3 generic
parts:
I'd like to develop packages that use Shiny to visualize/explore objects.  It would be useful to have an S3 generic defined to launch these apps directly based on on an object, along the lines of what `lineprof::shine` (though as an S3 generic, obviously).  Right now I'm in this weird situation where I want to use "shine" for my package, but can't as it will conflict with `lineprof::shine`.  Having Shiny define the `shine` generic would allow many packages to use that function name to activate an app based on an object without any conflicts.  Obviously `lineprof` would need minor modifications, but it seems worthwhile to me to do this.

Thoughts?
